overview: The Ten Thousand Immortals token app: mint TTTI-T with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or BTC, manage a wallet, trade on native pools, with an organized English admin console.
features: Mint TTTI-T with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or BTC
Mint revenue sent directly to the admin's wallet for each payment token
Mint fee kept in a dedicated contract account and shared with liquidity providers and permanent liquidity
Admin console grouped into clear sections with a single token selector
One filterable admin history and one filterable review list
Wallet, buyback, native pools and white paper in 7 languages
